title: Understand the Market Before You Automate It
author: Horror_Office_5737
selftext:
Been thinking about this a lot recently.  
I see a lot of people getting into AI/automated trading and wanting to build or use a bot almost immediately.  
I get the appeal, but I think there’s a step that gets missed: actually understanding the market and the strategy before automating it.  
A bot can execute rules. It doesn’t necessarily help you understand why those rules should work, when they might stop working, or what market conditions they’re operating in.  
I wrote a longer piece about this recently not arguing against trading bots, but more about why I think understanding should come before automation.  
Curious what people here think.
